page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r9i.large is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.r9i server family. It is built on the KVM hypervisor and features 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz. The instance utilizes the x86_64 CPU architecture.

This server type is configured with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.r9i.large is designed for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local storage or GPU acceleration. It offers qualitative cost efficiency for applications requiring high memory density relative to compute resources, such as small-scale databases, caching layers, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
